speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Multiple System Atrophy (Shy-Drager Syndrome)

The clinical picture of progressive gait difficulty, urinary incontinence, and speech changes, combined with MRI evidence of atrophy in the brainstem, cerebellum, and basal ganglia, strongly points to a degenerative neurodegenerative condition. The early onset of autonomic symptoms (incontinence) relative to motor symptoms is particularly characteristic of this diagnosis.
